$comment: Configuration of the M05 native runs (m05-plan §3) for m05-evidence.py (tests/native/m02/m02-evidence.py with the M05 constants). TEMPLATE: no native run has happened yet. The native-run step sets build_commit, started_at, artifacts_root (one directory per build, e.g. tests/evidence/artifacts/m05/exit-<commit>), environment, artifact digests and commands, regenerates tests/native/m05/required-inventory.json at that commit (tests/native/m05/refresh-inventory.sh: with fresh Linux and Windows scans, which add the platform-only tests the build host cannot list), and only then runs --write. Every logs, commands_logs and facts path below is relative to artifacts_root; a missing file stops the generator before anything is written. The wsl-distro row is the hook run inside one disposable distribution (tests/native/m05/wsl-hook-journeys.sh, wired into the Mode B distribution harness by the integrator).
commands: tests/native/m05/refresh-inventory.sh (regenerates tests/native/m05/required-inventory.json at the exit commit, with the Linux and Windows scans)
tests/native/m05/run-macos.sh <artifacts_root>/macos (check.sh: every workspace test, then the observation pass)

on the PC, by a T3 agent at Medium integrity: pwsh -NoProfile -File tests/native/m05/run-windows-local.ps1 -Commit <exit commit> -ScratchRoot <scratch root>; then on the build host: python3 -I tests/native/m02/import-windows-bundle.py --bundle <report> --label <artifacts_root name> --commit <exit commit> --artifacts-root tests/evidence/artifacts/m05 --config <artifacts_root>/runs.json

on the PC, in one disposable distribution created by the Mode B harness (a hm-m05-<8 hex> name, unregistered by exact name): tests/native/m05/wsl-hook-journeys.sh <scratch> <bindir> as the non-root user against the Linux build; its output is the wsl-distro bundle
common_limitations: Status discipline (m05-plan §3, M01 rule E15): verified rows mean the required tests ran and passed on that platform in this run; not an independent review of the units. The lowest-row rule applies: a blocked owner-input row (m05-plan §7: B2, B7, B9, B12) keeps its record blocked, and no claim is widened to cover it.

Linux and Windows binaries are cross-built on the macOS host with zig and run natively on the hosts (Windows: built and run natively on the PC); tests that read the repository at its compile-time path read it through HM_REPO_ROOT, which the harnesses set.
Two environments, one OS user: A16 runs two native environments in scratch homes on each platform; the WSL and container pairs are M04's exit (plan Q9).

The hook journeys need a Unix shell: native Windows has no shell integration (owner question Q6) and uses run and ordinary ssh; the WSL row runs bash and zsh inside one disposable distribution (ruling I-19).
Proptest regression files resolve at compile-time source paths: persisted regression seeds replay on macOS only; the fixed default seeds run everywhere.

Every fixture is disposable: per-run keys, the loopback fixture sshd, disposable ssh-agents with a scratch HOME, scratch configuration and Heimdall homes, a disposable WSL distribution; the owners' keys, agents, keychains, ~/.ssh and Git configuration are never test material.

A02.summary: A normal working week after one project trust: re-enter, three shells through the hook, Git, ssh and scp, a re-issue within a grant, the endpoint recovered after its runtime is stopped, expiry and re-entry; decisions, attended prompts and provider prompts all count 0 (R-UX-02). The default's ordinary-ssh rows. Windows uses run and ordinary ssh with no shell hook; WSL runs the hook journeys in a disposable distribution.
limitations: Blocked: the step comparison with the G01 baseline worksheet (B7, ADR-0001 §6; the human walkthrough is M09's), a reboot or logout inside the window (B12; M04-T04), the arm64 rows (B9).
Per ADR-0011 I-13 the first plain ssh on a free slot may fail once without the hook's warm-up; the record shows the per-platform outcome as an observation, never as a pass criterion.

A04.summary: Access changes: edits and branch switches make no decision; an added destination makes one decision showing only that pair; two live bindings stay unchanged; changing the default or the profile never redirects a live binding.

A05.summary: Expiry and the hard cutoff: the same work ID is refused after expiry, distinct work proceeds with no decision, and after a cutoff fresh work IDs, a restarted runtime, the hook and default activation are all refused; clearing needs an attended decision (R-AU-02).

A16.summary: Concurrent environments: defaults do not redirect running work; stopping one job leaves the other; cleanup leaves no binding or slot (R-AU-03). Two native environments in scratch homes, labelled two environments, one OS user.
limitations: deferred_with_decision to M04's exit (m05-plan Q9): the WSL pair and the container pair.

A18.summary: Portable trust: copy, clone, worktree, symlink, move and submodule identity; an export carries no authority or secrets; an import on a second installation creates intent only (R-EN-07).

A28.summary: Delegation: the child is server-enforced to its subset, a broader or longer child is refused, the child handle has no owner functions, the parent's end cascades and the child's next login fails (R-AU-07, R-SE-03). The managed rows.
limitations: deferred_with_decision to M04's exit (m05-plan Q9): A28's forwarding and container rows.

A29.summary: Hostile input: a repository file cannot become an approval instruction. A program without a terminal cannot decide, repository decision references find nothing, claims in names change nothing, self-authorizing manifests get nothing, hostile manifests, bundles, working directories and hook environments are refused or inert; M01's A29-local rows re-run by name (ruling I-18).
limitations: Blocked: the cross-user rows (B2) and the arm64 rows (B9).

Findings A29-F1 (a FIFO import bundle) and A29-F2 (pre-set hook state variables), and the W4 review's M05-W4-R01 (a duplicate bundle key) and M05-W4-R02 (other FIFO input files), were fixed in W4; their tests run unignored. Bundle refusal at any depth holds for the raw input because a repeated key is refused before the walk.

A29 tests are same-user: a same-user program that speaks the control protocol and declares itself interactive can attend (ADR-0011 R1); the claim is that repository, manifest and request content never becomes consent.

M05 exit cases (m05-plan §3).summary: m05-plan §3: every M05 exit case per platform, all rows from one build. G05 (tests/evidence/m05-g05-agent-context.json) is the cited hand-written gate record. Blocked while any owner-input row (B2, B7, B9, B12) is blocked (the lowest-row rule).
